definition: US value-weighted CRSP market total return (Mkt-RF + RF); real = relative to CPI-U NSA
caveats: Overlapping windows: effective independent observations ~ sample years / horizon (e.g. only ~10 non-overlapping 10-year periods since 1926).
US market is a survivor (ex-post the most successful large market); global evidence (e.g. Japan 1990-2020) shows longer losing spells.
